Cross-reference for INELOD VOC classes, object properties and data properties back to ToC

This section provides details for each class and property defined by INELOD VOC.

Classes

  • Census section
  • District
  • municipality
  • Reason type
  • Set of Measurements

Census sectionc back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://lod.ine.es/def/vocabulary/CensusSection

Unidad territorial de menor nivel definida por el INE para la organización del Censo Electoral. Identificada por un código de 10 dígitos: 2 de provincia + 3 de municipio + 2 de distrito + 3 de sección.
has super-classes
concept c
is in range of
Census section op

Districtc back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://lod.ine.es/def/vocabulary/District

Subdivisión administrativa de un municipio. En municipios grandes (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, etc.) los distritos agrupan secciones censales y son la unidad territorial intermedia entre el municipio y la sección censal.
has super-classes
concept c

municipalityc back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://lod.ine.es/def/vocabulary/Municipality

has super-classes
concept c

Reason typec back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://lod.ine.es/def/vocabulary/ReasonType

The cause or reason that moves something
is in range of
Reason for not seeking employment op, Reason for reduced activity op, Reason for seeking other job op, Reason for temporary contract op, Reasons for increased activity op, Reasons for not working op, Reasons for part-time work op, Type of reasons op

Set of Measurementsc back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://lod.ine.es/def/vocabulary/MeasureSet

La clase OWL que representa a aquellas variables del INE que corresponden al conjunto de medidas de un conjunto de datos
is in range of
In Measure Set op
has members
Datatype ni, Datatype Tourists ni, Indicator ni, Indicator type ni, Measures ni, Persons And Percentages Set ni, Rates ni, Rates for each 100k Inhabitants ni, Total expenditure: thousands of euros. Average expenditure: euros. ni, Total expenditure: thousands of euros. Unit value: euros/unit ni, Total quantity: thousands of units. Average quantity: units. ni, Unidades (value) ni, Unit Employed ni
